### Property Prediction for Steering PLM and Activation Steering Protein Optimization (ASPO)

The property prediction for **thermostability** and **solubility** can be achieved by calling the `estimate_therm` and `estimate_sol` functions in `estimation.py`.

#### Prerequisites & Dependencies

* **Required Package:** The `tgnn` package is required and can be found in the [TencentAI4S/ori GitHub repository](https://github.com/TencentAI4S/ori/tree/master/tgnn).
* **Model Checkpoints:** The ESM-2 650M-based model checkpoints for both the thermostability and solubility estimators are available for download on [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1q4YSu-BGZhLBDoITtQjZJJgKWbBEh34g/view?usp=sharing).
